title: Producer and consumer coroutines
description:
Pass values between two coroutines.

```
produced 1, consumed 1 (sum 1)
produced 2, consumed 2 (sum 3)
produced 3, consumed 3 (sum 6)
producer finished
```

starter.main.lua:
local producer = coroutine.create(function()
  for i = 1, 3 do
    coroutine.yield(i)
  end
end)

-- TODO: resume until it is dead
print(coroutine.status(producer))

hints: `local ok, value = coroutine.resume(producer)`; `value` is `nil` on the last resume, when the function returns (lesson 6.03).
`coroutine.wrap(function() for v in source do if v % 2 == 1 then coroutine.yield(v) end end end)` turns a coroutine into an iterator.
requirements: A consumer loop calls `coroutine.resume` until the producer is `dead`.
Write a `filter` coroutine between them that only lets odd numbers through, using `coroutine.wrap`.
stretch: Make the producer read lines from a file instead of counting.
